headline: Core PCE 3.0% vs 3.3%, October hike odds 33%, 74% for December, Q2 GDP revised to 2.2%
stance: Softer core PCE pushed the hike from October to December. The long end rose into it and the curve bear-steepened Wednesday.

news.head: Core PCE held at 3.0% in August
news.body: Against 3.3% expected, and 0.2% on the month versus 0.3%. A BEA methodology overhaul did part of the work.

news.head: October hike odds fell to 33%
news.body: Hold prices 65% for October. December carries 74%. October hike odds were 65% on Sep 25.

news.head: Micron set a sixth straight revenue record
news.body: FQ4 revenue $54.2bn, non-GAAP EPS $33.42 against $31.45 expected. Shares fell 1% after hours on capex.

news.head: Corn stocks topped every trade estimate
news.body: USDA put Sep 1 corn stocks at 2.095bn bushels, up 35% and a 7-year high. Corn fell 20c Wednesday.

implications: The hike moved to December, so the long end is a supply and term-premium market now. Jobs report, Oct 2, is the next test.
Corn specs sat at the 98th percentile of 3 years into a 7-year stocks high. Soybean and wheat specs are still above the 96th.

watch.head: ISM Manufacturing, 10:00
watch.body: September forecast 55.0 against 54.6 the prior month. Prices paid seen 72.5 from 71.1.

watch.head: Jobless claims, 8:30
watch.body: Initial claims 197k on the last print, 4-week average 202k. The labour read into Friday starts here.

watch.head: Jobs report, Oct 2, 8:30
watch.body: The October decision now turns on it. ISM Services, Oct 5, follows.

watch.head: Fed balance sheet, 4:30
watch.body: Reserves were $2,930bn in the week to Sep 23, down $84bn. This print carries the quarter-end turn.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: October is now a hold, December the hike. Rate vol rose Wednesday into that handoff.
Q2 GDP revised up 0.7 point to 2.2% Wednesday. Softer prices, firmer growth — the long end took the growth half.
Rubio ordered Iran's UN delegation out of New York Monday after talks stalled. Energy lifted August's PCE.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 22: euro specs fell to the 13th percentile of 3 years, a new extended short this week.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Only 21.9% of the S&P 500 closed above its 50-day line Wednesday, from 29.3% Friday.
Nikkei rose 2.5% overnight on Micron and a $200bn Korea energy pledge. KOSPI up 0.9%.
Equity risk premium fell to -2.53% at the September close, the third monthly drop in a row.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 22: VIX specs have sat extended short at the 15th percentile for 7 weeks.

single_name.note: GameStop: two insider rules fired, latest buy filed Sep 29. Above its 200-day, 4.3 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: IG and high yield widened since Friday's close while equities held. Credit is tracking the long end.
Equity-credit correlation rose to 0.63 Wednesday, the highest of the past week. One risk factor, not two.
The quarter-end turn passed Wednesday with no funding stress in the spreads.

ideas.line: 4 open · 3 closed — no hit rate until 10 (too few to mean anything)
